name: DigitalOcean Functions Monthly Free Allowance
free_limit: 90,000 GiB-seconds of Functions compute per team per month, shared across Functions and App Platform function components; 100 ms minimum billed runtime per invocation.
watch_out: A payment method is required to create resources. The recurring free allowance does not roll over; excess compute is billed at $0.0000185/GiB-second automatically. App Platform bandwidth and other resources may incur separate charges. The $5 signup credit expires after 90 days and is not part of this ongoing allowance. Card-specific and commercial-use terms are not independently confirmed.
